notes: Factorio 2.1.25 (Space Age + Quality + Elevated Rails) GameData v4 template. Primary sources: raw/factorio/2.1.25/prototype-api.json, raw/factorio/2.1.25/runtime-api.json, raw/factorio/2.1.25/script-output/data-raw-dump.json (Factorio 2.1.25). Secondary source: https://wiki.factorio.com/.

game.name: Factorio
game.notes: nutrients fuel_value=2MJ, bioflux fuel_value=6MJ from data-raw-dump.json (Factorio 2.1.25).

surfaces.notes: Playable surfaces from data-raw-dump.json (planet + surface, Factorio 2.1.25). Picker-only filter.

power_modes.notes: Switchable power modeling per GameData v4 cookbook.

qualities.notes: Quality tiers from data-raw-dump.json (quality) and prototype-api.json (QualityPrototype.default_multiplier = 1 + 0.3 * level, BeaconPrototype.distribution_effectivity = 1.5 + 0.2 * level, Factorio 2.1.25).

options.label: Normal
options.tooltip: 1x base machine speed & module stats; 1.5x beacon efficiency

options.label: Uncommon
options.tooltip: 1.3x machine speed & positive module stats; 1.7x beacon efficiency

options.label: Rare
options.tooltip: 1.6x machine speed & positive module stats; 1.9x beacon efficiency

options.label: Epic
options.tooltip: 1.9x machine speed & positive module stats; 2.1x beacon efficiency

options.label: Legendary
options.tooltip: 2.5x machine speed & positive module stats; 2.5x beacon efficiency

modules.notes: Module effects from data-raw-dump.json (module, Factorio 2.1.25). Positive bonuses and negative consumption scale with quality (ModulePrototype.*_quality_multiplier); penalties stay 1x.

research_speeds.notes: Cumulative laboratory-speed bonuses from data-raw-dump.json (research-speed-1..6: +20/+30/+40/+50/+50/+60%, Factorio 2.1.25).

solar_locations.notes: Planet surface averages (0.7 * solar-power / 100) and space orbit flat multipliers (solar_power_in_space / 100; default 1% at solar-system-edge) from data-raw-dump.json + prototype-api.json + https://wiki.factorio.com/Solar_panel (Factorio 2.1.25).

research_presets.notes: Technology unit cycle times and required science packs from data-raw-dump.json (technology, Factorio 2.1.25).

surface.label: Surface filter
surface.tooltip: Filter machines and recipes in the picker by planet or space platform. Does not alter already-placed nodes.

show_recycling.label: Show item recycling
show_recycling.tooltip: Show auto-generated item recycling recipes in the picker (Scrap recycling is always visible).

power_mode.label: Power mode
power_mode.tooltip: Display electric power as a metric, wire it as a solver resource to auto-size power plants, or both.

mining_productivity.label: Mining productivity
mining_productivity.tooltip: Mining productivity research level (+10% output per level for all mining drills and pumpjacks, uncapped).

research_productivity.label: Research productivity
research_productivity.tooltip: Research productivity level (+10% effective science per level in labs and biolabs, uncapped).

research_speed.label: Lab research speed
research_speed.tooltip: Lab research speed technology tier (multiplies lab speed alongside modules and beacons).

prod_steel.label: Steel plate productivity
prod_steel.tooltip: Steel plate productivity level (+10% per level on Steel plate and Casting steel; total recipe productivity caps at +300%).

prod_lds.label: Low density structure prod.
prod_lds.tooltip: Low density structure productivity level (+10% per level on Low density structure and Casting LDS; caps at +300%).

prod_plastic.label: Plastic bar productivity
prod_plastic.tooltip: Plastic bar productivity level (+10% per level on Plastic bar and Bioplastic; caps at +300%).

prod_processing_unit.label: Processing unit productivity
prod_processing_unit.tooltip: Processing unit productivity level (+10% per level on Processing unit; caps at +300%).

prod_rocket_fuel.label: Rocket fuel productivity
prod_rocket_fuel.tooltip: Rocket fuel productivity level (+10% per level on Rocket fuel, Rocket fuel from jelly, and Ammonia rocket fuel; caps at +300%).

prod_rocket_part.label: Rocket part productivity
prod_rocket_part.tooltip: Rocket part productivity level (+10% per level on Rocket part; caps at +300%).

prod_scrap.label: Scrap recycling productivity
prod_scrap.tooltip: Scrap recycling productivity level (+10% per level on Scrap recycling; caps at +300%).

prod_asteroid.label: Asteroid productivity
prod_asteroid.tooltip: Asteroid productivity level (+10% per level on all six asteroid crushing recipes; caps at +300%).

aquilo_heating.label: Aquilo heating
aquilo_heating.tooltip: Enable when this building is placed on Aquilo to include its separate thermal heat-pipe thaw load in Aquilo thaw heat totals (distinct from electrical power).

quality.label: Building quality
quality.tooltip: Quality tier of this building (scales crafting speed, pumping speed, power generation, or heat throughput).

modules.label: Modules
modules.tooltip: Modules inserted directly into this machine.

module_quality.label: Module quality
module_quality.tooltip: Quality tier of the modules slotted in this machine (scales beneficial effects; penalties remain unchanged).

beacon_count.label: Beacons
beacon_count.tooltip: Number of beacons in range of this machine (diminishing returns apply automatically).

beacon_quality.label: Beacon quality
beacon_quality.tooltip: Quality tier of the beacons affecting this machine (scales transmission efficiency from 1.5x to 2.5x).

beacon_modules.label: Beacon modules
beacon_modules.tooltip: Modules installed in each beacon affecting this machine (speed and efficiency modules only).

beacon_module_quality.label: Beacon module quality
beacon_module_quality.tooltip: Quality tier of the modules installed inside the beacons.

fuel.label: Fuel
fuel.tooltip: Chemical fuel burned by this machine.

steam_temp_165.label: Steam temperature
steam_temp_165.tooltip: Choose 165 °C boiler steam or 500 °C heat-exchanger / Vulcanus steam.

steam_temp_500.label: Steam temperature
steam_temp_500.tooltip: Choose 500 °C heat-exchanger / Vulcanus steam or 165 °C boiler steam.

patch_yield.label: Patch yield
patch_yield.tooltip: Current yield percentage of the fluid deposit (minimum 20%).

agri_plots.label: Plantable plots
agri_plots.tooltip: Number of fertile 3x3 plots planted around each agricultural tower (47 leaves 1 plot for logistics; 48 is theoretical maximum).

reactor_neighbors.label: Neighbor bonus
reactor_neighbors.tooltip: Average number of active adjacent nuclear reactors (+100% heat output per neighbor without burning extra fuel; e.g. 2 for a 2x2 array).

fusion_neighbors.label: Reactor neighbors
fusion_neighbors.tooltip: Average active neighbor bonus of the feeding fusion reactor (0–5, +100% plasma temperature per neighbor).

solar_location.label: Location
solar_location.tooltip: Planet surface (70% day/night average) or space platform orbit (constant 100% sunlight).

research_preset.label: Technology preset
research_preset.tooltip: Choose an infinite technology preset or select Custom to configure packs and cycle time manually.

research_cycle_time.label: Cycle time
research_cycle_time.tooltip: Base seconds per research unit for the custom technology.

aquilo_heating.label: Aquilo thaw heat
aquilo_heating.notes: Thermal heat-pipe load required to prevent buildings from freezing on Aquilo (EntityPrototype.heating_energy, Factorio 2.1.25). Plain MW unit enables case-sensitive SI auto-scaling; separate from electrical power; excludes heat pipes, inserters, and belts.

fa_base.notes: Shared base profile for picker filtering (global.surface, global.show_recycling), switchable power_mode ports/metrics, and Aquilo building thaw heat (Factorio 2.1.25).
fa_base.visible_if: (global.surface == 'all') || (global.surface == 'nauvis' && machine.on_nauvis) || (global.surface == 'vulcanus' && machine.on_vulcanus) || (global.surface == 'gleba' && machine.on_gleba) || (global.surface == 'fulgora' && machine.on_fulgora) || (global.surface == 'aquilo' && machine.on_aquilo) || (global.surface == 'space-platform' && machine.on_space)
fa_base.recipe_visible_if: (global.show_recycling || !recipe.is_auto_recycling) && ((global.surface == 'all') || (global.surface == 'nauvis' && recipe.on_nauvis) || (global.surface == 'vulcanus' && recipe.on_vulcanus) || (global.surface == 'gleba' && recipe.on_gleba) || (global.surface == 'fulgora' && recipe.on_fulgora) || (global.surface == 'aquilo' && recipe.on_aquilo) || (global.surface == 'space-platform' && recipe.on_space))

fa_crafter.notes: All 17 crafting machines, furnaces, and rocket-silo. Sources: prototype-api.json (CraftingMachinePrototype, EffectReceiver, ModulePrototype, BeaconPrototype, QualityPrototype, RecipePrototype), data-raw-dump.json (Factorio 2.1.25), https://wiki.factorio.com/Beacon, https://wiki.factorio.com/Pollution.

let.tech_prod: if(recipe.prod_tech == 'steel', global.prod_steel * 0.1, if(recipe.prod_tech == 'lds', global.prod_lds * 0.1, if(recipe.prod_tech == 'plastic', global.prod_plastic * 0.1, if(recipe.prod_tech == 'processing-unit', global.prod_processing_unit * 0.1, if(recipe.prod_tech == 'rocket-fuel', global.prod_rocket_fuel * 0.1, if(recipe.prod_tech == 'rocket-part', global.prod_rocket_part * 0.1, if(recipe.prod_tech == 'scrap', global.prod_scrap * 0.1, if(recipe.prod_tech == 'asteroid', global.prod_asteroid * 0.1, 0))))))))

fa_miner.notes: Burner/Electric/Big Mining Drills and Pumpjack. Speed does not scale with quality; mining_productivity is uncapped; infinite fluid patches scale by patch_yield/100 (confirmed in-game on Factorio 2.1.25: crude-oil 10/s, sulfuric-acid-geyser 10/s, fluorine-vent 1/s; finite lithium-brine flat 1/s). Drills have 0 auto-drain (prototype-api.json MiningDrillPrototype).

fa_offshore.notes: Offshore pump: pumping_speed = 20/tick = 1200/s at Normal, scaled by 1 + 0.3 * level (data-raw-dump.json, runtime-api.json LuaEntityPrototype.get_pumping_speed, Factorio 2.1.25). Void energy source (0 MW).

fa_agriculture.notes: Agricultural tower: 1 seed -> harvest in growth_ticks/60 s divided by agri_plots (default 47, max 48). Active power 100 kW (0 idle drain). Spores = tower 4/min + harvest_emissions.spores * agri_plots * 60 / recipe.time (15 spores per Yumako/Jellystem harvest = 3 * agri_plots / min; 0 for Nauvis trees). Sources: data-raw-dump.json (agricultural-tower, plant), prototype-api.json, https://wiki.factorio.com/Agricultural_tower (Factorio 2.1.25).

fa_boiler.notes: Boiler (1.8 MW chemical -> 60 steam-165c/s from 6 water/s, 30/min pollution) and Heat Exchanger (10 MW heat -> 103.09278 steam-500c/s from 10.30928 water/s). Throughput, fuel, and pollution scale by quality 1 + 0.3 * level (data-raw-dump.json, prototype-api.json BoilerPrototype, https://wiki.factorio.com/Quality, Factorio 2.1.25).

fa_generator.notes: Steam Engine (30 steam-165c/s -> 0.9 MW) and Steam Turbine (60 steam-500c/s -> 5.82 MW, or 60 steam-165c/s -> 1.80 MW). Fluid usage and power output scale by quality 1 + 0.3 * level (data-raw-dump.json, runtime-api.json LuaEntityPrototype.get_max_power_output, https://wiki.factorio.com/Quality, Factorio 2.1.25).

fa_reactor.notes: Nuclear Reactor (40 MW * q_mult base, 1 uranium-fuel-cell / (200 / q_mult) s -> depleted cell + 40 * q_mult * (1 + neighbors) MW heat) and Heating Tower (40 MW * q_mult heat at 250% efficiency = 16 MW * q_mult chemical fuel, 100 * q_mult / min pollution). Sources: data-raw-dump.json, prototype-api.json ReactorPrototype, https://wiki.factorio.com/Nuclear_reactor, https://wiki.factorio.com/Heating_tower (Factorio 2.1.25).

fa_fusion_reactor.notes: Fusion Reactor: consumes 1 fusion-power-cell / (400 / q_mult) s and 4 * q_mult / s fluoroketone-cold -> 4 * q_mult / s fusion-plasma. Electric power_input is fixed at 10 MW regardless of quality (confirmed in-game on Factorio 2.1.25 with Legendary fusion reactor). Neighbor bonus plasma temperature is configured on fa_fusion_generator to guarantee 1:1 fluoroketone conservation.

fa_fusion_generator.notes: Fusion Generator: outputs 50 * q_mult MW, consuming 2 * q_mult / (1 + fusion_neighbors) plasma/s and returning equal fluoroketone-hot/s (conserving fluoroketone 1:1 with the feeding Fusion Reactor across all qualities and neighbor bonuses 0..5). Sources: data-raw-dump.json, prototype-api.json FusionGeneratorPrototype, https://wiki.factorio.com/Fusion_generator (Factorio 2.1.25).

fa_solar.notes: Solar Panel: 60 kW * q_mult peak * solar_location.solar_mult (70% day/night average on planets, 100% flat in orbit). Outputs typed power (MW) directly on out:0 (native_power_out = true) and never double-emits xout:power_out. Decoupled from global.surface so multi-planet graphs never silently recalculate. Sources: data-raw-dump.json (solar-panel, planet, space-location), https://wiki.factorio.com/Solar_panel (Factorio 2.1.25).

fa_lab.notes: Lab (speed 1, 60 kW, 2 slots, 100% drain) and Biolab (speed 2, 300 kW, 4 slots, 50% drain, 8/min pollution, Nauvis-only). Speed = base * q_mult * (1 + research_speed) * max(0.2, 1 + mod_speed + beacon_speed); research_productivity is uncapped; no quality modules allowed (prototype-api.json LabPrototype, https://wiki.factorio.com/Lab, Factorio 2.1.25).

let.pack_count: if(param.research_preset.is_custom, if(param.pack_automation, 1, 0) + if(param.pack_logistic, 1, 0) + if(param.pack_military, 1, 0) + if(param.pack_chemical, 1, 0) + if(param.pack_production, 1, 0) + if(param.pack_utility, 1, 0) + if(param.pack_space, 1, 0) + if(param.pack_metallurgic, 1, 0) + if(param.pack_agricultural, 1, 0) + if(param.pack_electromagnetic, 1, 0) + if(param.pack_cryogenic, 1, 0) + if(param.pack_promethium, 1, 0), 1)

requires.message: Enable at least one science pack

fa_spoiling.notes: Passive item spoiling conversions from ItemPrototype.spoil_result and spoil_ticks / 60 (Factorio 2.1.25). 0 MW, 0 pollution.
